title: Bollplank configuration (~/.bollplank/config.json)
description: Documents the shape for editors. lib/config.mjs validate() is what Bollplank enforces.

name.description: The person whose explicit words approve a brief and accept a ticket.

copyStyle.description: How briefs and comments are written.

team.description: The default team for projects that name none. On Jira, the site, such as acme.atlassian.net.

project.description: The default board project for projects that name none. On Jira, the project key, such as ACME.

statuses.description: The status names for projects that map none of their own. A name left out is the board kind's suggestion.

same.description: Model and effort for a critic from the same provider as the lead.

shipLock.description: The shipping lock folder. Point it at another kit's lock to share one turn.

space.description: Jira only: the Confluence space key that holds the Release notes page.

checks.description: The PR checks that must be green before a merge. Required when the project has runs on.

disposable.description: Ignored paths that ticket remove deletes without asking, such as build output. Patterns from the repo root: * within a folder name, ** for zero or more folders, a trailing / for a folder only. Relative, without . or .. folders, and with a letter or digit. Bollplank's own validation also checks how ** is placed.

command.description: For command: run with {commit} replaced, in a clean checkout of the commit.

profile.description: For amplify: the AWS profile, when one is needed.

workflow.description: For github-actions: the name, file name or id of the workflow to wait for.

shipOrder.description: The order repos merge and deploy in. When given, it lists every configured repo exactly once.

default.description: This project's critic default. It wins over the top level critic.default.

kind.description: This project's board kind. Left out, the top level board.kind. A kind other than the top level one must set its own team, project and all five statuses.

statuses.description: This project's own status names. A name left out comes from the top level board.statuses.
